safe_area.note: 1080x1920 px; bottom keeps clear of platform UI

rtl_rules: Store text in logical (spoken) order; never pre-reverse strings in SRT/JSON.
In After Effects/Premiere use the Middle Eastern / South Asian text engine with RTL paragraph direction.
Latin terms inside Arabic lines stay LTR runs; do not split a Latin term across lines.
Never break a line between a number and its unit, or inside a Latin medical term.
